Game Overview

Cheesy Run is a runner title where embark on an exhilarating dash as a fearless hamster fleeing a relentless cat. Navigate through obstacles, snag power-ups, and collect cheese to boost your speed and unlock quirky abilities. With every frantic scamper, the chase intensifies, testing your reflexes and wits in this thrilling, cheese-laden adventure!

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Cheesy Run is easy to pick up. Embark on an exhilarating dash as a fearless hamster fleeing a relentless cat.
